old_problem: The equal-mix M.2 title conflicts with a literal 70% read/30% write setting; destructive namespace, extent, duration and acceptance limits are missing.
disposition_reason: ED-04 supplies the safety envelope but cannot decide whether the title or explicit ratio is authoritative. Changing `rwmixread` changes both coverage and NAND write exposure, requiring source-owner approval.

test_case.test_name: M.2 FIO QD1 512B equal-mix validation pending ratio decision
test_case.purpose: Measure the authoritative M.2 mixed-random ratio with separately assessed read/write IOPS, bandwidth and latency.
required_package: Pinned fio build and reviewed job digest
Disposable namespace with serial/controller/BDF mapping, bounded extent and access mode
Data-loss approval, NVMe endurance/health abort policy and owner recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not execute the contradictory job. When ratio authority is recorded, revalidate the disposable namespace and exclude OS/boot/mounted/RAID/open holders, capture health, run one bounded QD1 512B job using only the approved ratio, save fio JSON/NVMe telemetry, and leave format/remount to the owner.
test_case.expected_result: The authorized mix and no other profile runs on the designated namespace, meets approved limits and leaves NVMe/platform health acceptable.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires a ratio-authoritative job and ratio-specific limits; a 70/30 output cannot be labeled 50/50.
safety_gate: Block until ratio plus data-loss approval are explicit.
Verify serial/controller/BDF and reject protected or active namespaces.
Pin size/time and inspect health/endurance before launch.
Abort on NVMe critical warning/media/thermal/power limits; no retry.
expected_evidence: Pre/post NVMe health/endurance and kernel evidence
fio JSON proving actual ratio and metrics
test_case.recovery: If fio reports the unapproved ratio or namespace health changes, stop the sole job, preserve job/output/error-log evidence, isolate the namespace from mounts, and require M.2 owner review before any reformat or reuse.
